The role / impact

You will deliver high-quality, impactful software that aligns with team and business goals, always keeping customer needs and outcomes front of mind. By identifying and solving complex, ambiguous problems independently, you will produce robust, high-quality, and scalable software that helps change the world by supporting small businesses. Your daily work will focus on systems, scalability, and engineering quality while collaborating across teams to drive technical excellence and developer efficiency.

Through clear and thoughtful communication, you will ensure stakeholders are well-informed and aligned. You will play a key part in fostering an inclusive team culture by mentoring others and sharing feedback with empathy. Your active participation in planning, delivery, and continuous improvement will contribute directly to the success of the broader Xero community.

The team / how they connect

You will join the Payments team within Product Platforms, which forms the critical foundation underneath core product areas like invoices, bills, payments, and payroll. The team exists to make it easy for other groups across Xero to build on a strong foundation of accounting concepts, data, and libraries safely and efficiently. Operating across Wellington and Vancouver, we collaborate closely to reduce tight coupling, establish clear service boundaries, and accelerate product velocity global-wide.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

  • Transitioning from a monolithic architecture to modern microservices to remove delivery bottlenecks and improve efficiency.

  • Building and operating services in a production cloud environment utilizing C#, .NET Core, and AWS.

  • Resolving complex legacy problems, database scalability challenges, and modernizing service interfaces or APIs.

  • Automating manual processes and applying test-driven and trunk-based development practices.

Where and how you can work

This role is based at our on-site location in Vancouver. We operate on a hybrid model where you will spend one to two days a week in the office for collaborative technical discussions and team alignment, with the flexibility to work from home on the other days. You will also have the opportunity to travel to New Zealand for onboarding after your first couple of weeks.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

  • You bring proficient backend development experience with one or more programming languages such as C#, .NET, Java, or Go.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including service-to-service communication, eventual consistency, and resilience patterns belongs in your toolkit.

  • Your background features practical experience working with relational databases where transactional data integrity and ACID principles are critical.

  • Having a familiar working knowledge of modern DevOps practices, automated testing, and continuous integration pipelines will help you succeed.
